managed_hermes_backups: Managed Hermes backups are automated daily and retained for 7 days.
The dashboard supports restore, download and restore history.
Restoring replaces all current application files and cannot be undone.
managed_to_vps_switch: Switching from Managed Hermes to a VPS plan is a subscription change, not a data migration.
Managed Hermes setup and data do not move to the VPS.
Memory, agents, configurations and conversation history are not transferred.
self_hosted_hermes_backup: Hermes docs define hermes backup and hermes import for Hermes-created backup zips.
Hermes backup includes the whole Hermes home, including settings, profiles, memory, conversations, scheduled jobs and secrets.
self_hosted_importers: Hermes import-agent supports OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot and OpenBot.
Managed Hermes backup download is not documented as a supported import source.

documented: Managed Hermes backup download/restore exists within Managed Hermes dashboard.
Self-hosted Hermes can restore Hermes-created backup zips using hermes import.
Managed Hermes to VPS switch does not transfer data.
unknown: Whether a Managed Hermes downloaded backup has the same format/semantics as a hermes backup zip.
